hypothesis: A bounded original-human numeral auxiliary loss can improve speaker-disjoint raw numeral-category prediction using the approved backbone and complete 101-value numeric head.
limits: Category annotations, not reviewed transcripts or complete-command labels.
No supplied brightness role, presence, request-validity, span or ownership supervision.
Does not qualify any intent, supplied slot confidence, complete command or physical Pi use case.
29 observed categories within 0-100; the complete 101-value head and complete parent catalog remain unchanged.
One seed and one bounded recipe: no claim of superiority over the prescribed six full-command arms.
New component partition of historical source audio, not a fresh blind full-command holdout.
Source-qualified declared people; cross-source aliases and near duplicates remain unverified.
Kaggle version 3 reports licenseName Unknown; no raw audio or fitted weights redistributed.

sources.local_audio_view: Original-human MLEnd_numerals rows in the existing hash-bound auxiliary view; read-only
sources.label_review: Exact original filename, category and speaker-ID match; independent listening not performed

split_audit.assignment: Sort declared people by SHA256(seed/person), then floor fractions; no recording-level random split
split_audit.reserved: Exclude people/file hashes/PCM hashes/pair IDs present in ANY frozen parent train, dev, calibration, test or holdout view
split_audit.conflicts: Quarantine all eligible records with conflicting numeric labels under equal file/PCM/pair identity
split_audit.duplicates: Stable seed/id ranking, one copy per file/PCM/pair before speaker/value cap
split_audit.repeated_take_cap: one original take per person/category, selected before fitting; no deletions
split_audit.coverage_gate: Every retained observed numeric category must occur in train, dev and test
split_audit.audio_gate: Verify file and decoded PCM SHA256, mono 16kHz, 400-128000 samples, finite amplitude <=1
split_audit.gender: Document supplied metadata or unknown; no audio-based gender inference or gender routing
split_audit.intonation: Record neutral/bored/excited/question counts; all takes for a person stay in one partition

architecture: Unchanged IntentSlotsVCM, 40 bins, width 128, eight temporal blocks, all heads and full selected catalog retained
normalization: Reuse previously frozen original human-train-only 40-bin statistics; no component dev/test fitting
loss: Only full 101-way brightness_percent head cross entropy against isolated numeral CATEGORY labels
frozen_heads: All heads except brightness_percent; inactive query rows retain exact weights
sampler: uniform numeric category, then person, then original recording
selection: Development raw numeric macro-person top1; lower development NLL on accuracy tie; tolerance 0.0001; earlier checkpoint wins other ties
early_stopping: Two consecutive nonimproving checks or declared ceiling; no increase after seeing results
overtraining_audit: Report train/dev macro-person accuracy, NLL, exposure counts and selected/stopping check
test_policy: Complete component-specific source/data/graph/normalization/selected-weight lock before held-person component scoring
